listing.name: Lightshow
listing.summary: Ever died to a High Intensity Laser beam that looked just like a much tamer Graviton Beam? Ever got all your weapons disabled because the Ion Beam also look like it? Didn't liked that?
listing.aiSummary: Changes the visual appearance of vanilla beam weapons to color-code them by damage type.

description:
Download
NexusMods mirror

Ever died to a High Intensity Laser beam that looked just like a much tamer Graviton Beam? Ever got all your weapons disabled because the Ion Beam also look like it? Didn't liked that? Well this is a pretty straightforward utility mini-mod that changes the look of all vanilla beams to better differentiate them. They are now color coded for their damage type rather than for aesthetic choices. They might seem odd at first, but it will make your life in the sector slightly easier.

If some of the new colors aren't to your tastes, you can go in the mod's data/weapons folder and simply delete the weapons you want to keep unchanged. *Click to enlarge*

aiDescription: Replaces the aesthetic coloring of all vanilla beams with colors corresponding to their damage types. This helps players distinguish between similar-looking weapons like High Intensity Lasers and Graviton Beams. Users can manually delete specific weapon files in the mod's data folder if they prefer the original appearance for certain beams.
